{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    threshold = case['utility_threshold']
    removable = [n for n in nodes if n['removable']]
    removable.sort(key=lambda x: x['utility'], reverse=True)
    selected = []
    total = 0.0
    for n in removable:
        if total >= threshold:
            break
        total += n['utility']
        selected.append(n['id'])
    return selected
"}
